# #753 — No .prettierignore: a bulk format run would rewrite 1472 files including 701 markdown and generated standards copies

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-25T13:09:30Z
Updated: 2026-08-25T13:32:28Z

---

Agent-filed (open-brain head session, 2026-08-25). Blocks session 2 of #750.

## Measured

`.prettierrc.json` landed in b2d4252. There is no `.prettierignore`:

```
ls .prettierignore   -> No such file or directory
bunx prettier --check .   -> exit 1, 1472 files
```

Running `bun run format` today rewrites all 1472.

| Kind | Files |
|---|---|
| Markdown | 701 |
| TypeScript / JavaScript | 517 |
| Everything else (JSON, YAML, etc.) | ~254 |

By top-level path: `docs` 335, `_plans` 328, `src` 280, `.mypy_cache` 187,
`scripts` 99, `server` 92, `contracts` 40, `eval` 35, `python` 27,
`clients` 13, `.claude` 9, `_DOCS` 9.

## Why this blocks the reformat session

Three separate problems, only one of which is the intended work:

1. **`.mypy_cache/` (187 files) is a build artifact.** Reformatting it is
   pure noise and it should never have been a candidate.
2. **`_DOCS/STANDARDS-*.md` are GENERATED** and carry a `source-hash`
   (`AGENTS.md`, and repo `HANDOFF-RULES.md` rule 12). Reformatting them
   forks them from their source; the next
   `sync-repo-standards` run reverts it and the diff churns forever.
3. **701 markdown files** includes `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, every file in
   `_plans/`, and the SME knowledge base. Prose reflow is not what "adopt the
   formatter" means, and it buries the 517 code files that ARE the point
   under an unreviewable diff.

`docs/sme/` is additionally generated from `docs/sme/entries/` by
`bun scripts/build-sme-indexes.ts` — same fork risk as the standards copies.

## Fix

Add `.prettierignore` before any `--write` run. At minimum:

```
.mypy_cache/
node_modules/
_DOCS/STANDARDS-*.md
docs/sme/*.md
bun.lock
```

Then decide, explicitly rather than by default, whether markdown is in scope
for this repo's formatter at all. The exemplar formats its own docs, but it
does not carry generated standards copies or a 328-file `_plans/` tree.

Recommendation: restrict `format` to code globs (`src`, `server`, `scripts`,
`contracts`, `eval`, `clients`, `tests`), leave prose alone. That makes the
reformat commit reviewable and keeps generated files stable.

## Done means

- `.prettierignore` exists and excludes build artifacts and generated files.
- `bunx prettier --check <scope>` names only files the repo intends to format.
- The decision about markdown is recorded, not implicit.

## Note

The pre-commit hook already runs prettier on STAGED files only, so this does
not block ordinary commits today — a commit touching one `.ts` file is checked
against that file alone. It blocks the bulk `format` session.
